previous_statement: By compressed-product-display, applied uniformly at every amplification supplied by def-hcb-datum, there are universal K_dot and e_dot>0 such that ||Z^dagger dot Z-Z^dagger Z|| <= K_dot e ||Z||^2; the involution is isometric by epsilon-banach-cstar-norm-axioms.
new_statement: The registered compressed-product-display proves only the level-one estimate: there are universal K_dot<infinity and e_dot>0 such that, for Z in S_P and e<=e_dot, ||Z^dagger dot Z-Z^dagger Z|| <= K_dot e ||Z||^2. Neither compressed-product-display nor def-hcb-datum supplies a corresponding estimate on M_n tensor S_P for arbitrary n; thus the original uniform-amplification assertion is withdrawn and node 1.1 remains unsupported by the allowed inputs.
